Carlos: Heads up — Horizon security pre-call scheduled 10am PST tomorrow. They want: RBAC snapshot export, sample audit logs for a tenant, KMS key provenance timeline, and our vuln triage notes.
Amy: I can pull RBAC snapshot from prod-ops, but need to confirm scope (org vs tenant). Which do they want?
Carlos: They asked for tenant-level roles + service account mappings. Not full org. Keep PII redacted.
Ben: For audit logs, we can provide a 24h sample with actions, but must remove user IPs and redact email addresses. I'll prepare a SIEM-friendly jsonl export. Example command:
```
./tools/export_audit --tenant=horizon --start=2024-11-01T00:00:00Z --end=2024-11-02T00:00:00Z --format=jsonl --redact=ip,email > horizon_audit_sample.jsonl
```
Amy: Reminder — if we redact emails we should replace with placeholder `user:<hash>` so the event chain stays analyzable.
Sara: KMS provenance — do they need key creation + rotation events or full HSM attestations?
Carlos: They asked for key lifecycle events + rotation timestamps and which KMS alias was used. No HSM artifacts. Provide key-ids and rotation history.
Amy: Note — rotation events are only stored for 3 years in our audit index; confirm retention is ok.
Ben: On SIEM ingestion: we'll include mapping doc for Splunk/Elastic, sample ingest rule, and our recommended field mapping (tenant_id, request_id, actor, action, resource, outcome).
sec-bot: Reminder — redact_token=true is enabled for exported logs by default. See https://internal.redwood.dev/sec/export-guides
Sara: Vulnerability triage — Horizon flagged CVE-2025-0246 on an infra image. We're tracking in GH issue #827; mitigation planned for tomorrow's patch window.
Carlos: Good. For the call, let's have 3 artifacts: RBAC CSV (tenant mapping), audit sample jsonl, and KMS rotation timeline CSV + short memo.
Amy: I'll file a quick runbook with steps to reproduce RBAC snapshot and include export command.
Ben: I'll upload the audit sample to their secure share (sftp link) and send pre-call access.
Sara: I'll draft the KMS timeline and signoff note with key ids.
Carlos: Can we have everything uploaded by 8am PST?
Amy: Yes — I'll aim for 7:30.
Ben: Same.
Sara: Done, I'll ping when draft is ready. :thumbsup: 
Carlos: Thanks all. Last check — anyone see any PII risk we missed?
Amy: Just double-check email and IP redaction. Also mask user-agent strings if they contain emails.
Ben: Agree. Use the export flag `--scrub-ua`.
sec-bot: Audit export status: job queued (id: ae-77210). ETA ~45m.
Carlos: Cool. Post updates here and add artifacts to the call agenda doc: https://docs.redwood.dev/security/horizon-precall
